rules.heading: WEARING NEW CLOTHES, ORNAMENTS, CORAL, ETC.

planetary.freeform: Except Rikta tithis (4, 9, 14) and days of Saturday, Monday, and Tuesday (except that red clothes on Tuesday are auspicious)

exclusions: women whose husband is living wearing new clothes in Dhruwa nakshatras, Punarvasu, and Pushya
rules.notes: Wearing new clothes and ornaments is generally prescribed on good nakshatras excluding Rikta tithis and certain days, but married women should avoid Dhruwa nakshatras, Punarvasu, and Pushya for wearing new clothes.

rules.heading: THE EFFECTS WHEN A NEW CLOTH IS BURNT, TORN AND SOAKED IN MUD

planetary.freeform: If a new cloth is burnt, torn, or soaked in mud in the part belonging to the demons (middle 3 parts when divided into 9 parts)

rules.notes: If a new cloth is damaged in the demonic portion of the 9-fold division, it portends inauspicious results.
